title: Go-to-Market Specialist – Product & Market Insights
description:
About RENPHO

Established in 2016, RENPHO is a global wellness technology company dedicated to making smart, innovative, and accessible wellness solutions part of everyday life. Guided by our mission to “Empower Your Wellness,” we develop thoughtfully designed products across health, wellness, recovery, and beauty.

Our growing product ecosystem includes smart health devices, massage and recovery products, and beauty innovations designed to help people better understand their bodies, improve their daily routines, and live healthier lives. At RENPHO, we combine technology, consumer insights, and user-centered design to create practical products that meet the evolving needs of consumers worldwide.

About the Role

RENPHO is seeking a curious, resourceful, and market-driven Go-to-Market Specialist – Product & Market Insights to help identify new product opportunities and support product-related business decisions through hands-on market research.

This position will study consumer needs, competitor products, emerging trends, and gaps in the market. The ideal candidate enjoys exploring retail stores, observing how products are presented and purchased, comparing products firsthand, and translating market findings into clear and practical recommendations.

You will work closely with our Product Development, Marketing, Sales, and Leadership teams to help determine which product categories, features, colors, designs, materials, and price points may offer strong opportunities for RENPHO.

Key Responsibilities

Market and Consumer Research

Monitor consumer preferences, lifestyle trends, purchasing behavior, and emerging product categories.
Identify unmet consumer needs and potential gaps in the market.
Research which product types, features, colors, materials, designs, and price points are gaining consumer interest.
Analyze customer reviews, social media conversations, marketplace activity, and other sources of consumer feedback.
Track relevant developments within the health, wellness, recovery, beauty, and consumer technology industries.
Summarize research findings and explain how they may influence future product decisions.

Competitive Product Analysis

Research and evaluate competitor products, product portfolios, pricing, positioning, features, packaging, and customer feedback.
Compare competitor products with RENPHO’s existing products to identify strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities for improvement.
Monitor new product launches and changes in competitor strategies.
Purchase, test, or examine relevant products when needed and provide structured findings.
Maintain organized and up-to-date competitive product and category analyses.

New Product and Market Opportunities

Identify promising product categories and new market opportunities that align with RENPHO’s capabilities and growth strategy.
Recommend potential new products, product extensions, feature improvements, colors, designs, and positioning opportunities.
Evaluate whether a product opportunity addresses a meaningful consumer need and offers a clear competitive advantage.
Help assess the target audience, market potential, price range, sales channels, and competitive environment for proposed products.
Develop clear product opportunity briefs supported by consumer insights, competitor research, and market observations.
Identify potential opportunities to enter new consumer segments or expand existing product categories.

Field and Retail Research

Regularly visit retail stores, shopping centers, showrooms, and other relevant market locations to observe products and consumer trends firsthand.
Attend trade shows, industry events, and product exhibitions when needed.
Review product assortments, retail displays, packaging, pricing, promotions, and product positioning in different retail environments.
Document field observations through photos, notes, product comparisons, and market visit reports.
Travel locally and occasionally to other markets to gather firsthand insights.

Go-to-Market Support

Support go-to-market planning by providing insights related to target consumers, competitor positioning, pricing, product features, and market trends.
Help define the key consumer need, competitive advantage, target audience, and selling points for potential products.
Work with Marketing and Sales teams to evaluate how products should be positioned in the market.
Provide market insights that support product launch and channel decisions.
Monitor market response following a product launch and recommend adjustments when appropriate.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Present market findings and product recommendations to leadership and cross-functional teams.
Partner with Product Development to translate market insights into potential product concepts and product requirements.
Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and other stakeholders to evaluate product positioning and launch opportunities.
Communicate research findings in a concise, practical, and visually clear format.
Manage multiple research projects and priorities in a fast-moving environment.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Product Development, Consumer Insights, Design, or a related field preferred.
Three or more years of experience in market research, product marketing, product strategy, consumer insights, merchandising, category management, or a related role preferred.
Strong interest in consumer products, product innovation, retail trends, and changing consumer preferences.
Ability to evaluate products from both consumer and business perspectives.
Strong research, analytical, observational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to turn broad market information into focused and actionable product recommendations.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
Comfortable working independently, visiting stores, conducting field research, and exploring unfamiliar product categories.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, or equivalent tools.
Experience with consumer products, retail, e-commerce, or major marketplace platforms is preferred.
Ability and willingness to travel locally and occasionally beyond the local market.

What We Are Looking For

Naturally curious and highly observant.
Excited to explore stores, products, consumer behavior, and emerging trends.
Able to notice details such as colors, materials, packaging, features, pricing, and product placement.
Commercially minded and able to distinguish a meaningful market opportunity from a short-lived trend.
Comfortable forming a point of view and supporting recommendations with evidence.
Proactive, adaptable, and willing to conduct both desk research and hands-on field research.
Able to work effectively across departments and communicate with different stakeholders.
Open to testing ideas, learning from the market, and adjusting recommendations based on new information.

Measures of Success

Success in this position may include:

Identifying practical and actionable new product or category opportunities.
Delivering timely and useful competitive and market analyses.
Providing insights that influence product development and product improvement.
Helping RENPHO better understand consumer preferences and market direction.
Improving the quality and speed of product-related business decisions.
Supporting stronger product positioning and go-to-market strategies.

Work Environment

This position combines office-based research, cross-functional collaboration, and hands-on field research. The employee should be comfortable regularly visiting retail locations and occasionally attending trade shows, industry events, product exhibitions, or other relevant market locations.

title: App Community Growth Specialist
description:
About the Company

At RENPHO, we are driven by the mission to make wellness accessible to everyone. From smart scales and massagers to fitness devices, our innovative products bridge the gap between technology and personal well-being. With a global presence and over 20 millions of customers, we are dedicated to delivering products that enhance lives, promote healthier habits, and improve overall well-being.
Founded in 2016, we grew to become a market leader on Amazon with its smart consumer electronics products. With offices in Los Angeles, Europe, Hong Kong, Korea, Taiwan and Tokyo. We are currently looking to expand our team.

Job Summary

We are seeking a creative and community-focused App Community Growth Specialist to build, manage, and grow our app community. This role will be responsible for creating an engaging user environment, increasing community participation, encouraging referral activities, and developing strategies to improve user engagement and retention.

The ideal candidate understands mobile app communities, user behavior, digital engagement, and creative community-building strategies. This person will help transform our app community from a user platform into an active and connected ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities:

App Community Management & Growth

Manage and grow the app-based user community by creating an engaging and interactive experience.
Develop community strategies to increase user participation, engagement, and retention.
Monitor community activities, identify trends, and recommend improvements.
Build programs that encourage users to return, participate, and share the app with others.

User Engagement & Community Activities

Create engaging content, discussions, challenges, campaigns, and interactive activities within the app community.
Develop creative initiatives to make the community experience more fun, valuable, and memorable.
Encourage user-generated content and meaningful conversations among community members.
Recognize and nurture active users and community advocates.

Referral Program Engagement

Develop creative campaigns to increase referral participation and user acquisition.
Identify opportunities to motivate users to invite friends and expand the community.
Analyze referral activities and provide recommendations to improve conversion and engagement.
Collaborate with marketing teams on referral campaigns and promotions.

Community Feedback & User Insights

Serve as the voice of the app community by collecting and analyzing user feedback.
Identify user needs, pain points, and opportunities to improve the app experience.
Work closely with Product, Marketing, and Customer Support teams to communicate community insights.

Community Performance Tracking

Track and analyze key community metrics, including:
Active community users
User engagement rate
Referral participation
Campaign performance
User retention
Prepare reports and recommendations to improve community growth.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Growth, and Customer Experience teams.
Support app launches, feature releases, and user engagement initiatives.
Assist in developing strategies to strengthen the overall app ecosystem.

Qualifications

* 5+ years of experience in community management, app operations, social media, digital
marketing, or user engagement.
* Experience managing online communities or mobile app communities preferred.
* Strong understanding of user engagement strategies and community-building practices.
* Creative mindset with the ability to develop campaigns and interactive experiences.
* Strong communication skills and ability to connect with users.
* Data-driven approach with the ability to analyze engagement performance.
* Experience with referral programs, consumer apps, or digital platforms is a plus.

title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description:
About the Company

At RENPHO, our mission is to make wellness accessible, practical, and part of everyday life. We design smart, user-friendly products—from body composition scales to massage and fitness devices—that seamlessly integrate technology with personal well-being.
Since our founding in 2016, RENPHO has grown into a leading global brand in consumer health technology, serving over 20 million users worldwide. Our products are trusted by customers across major marketplaces, including Amazon, where we have established a strong market presence.
As we continue to expand globally, we remain focused on innovation, data-driven insights, and delivering meaningful experiences that help people better understand and improve their wellness and health journey .

About the Role
Renpho is seeking a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own the execution and optimization of customer communication across email and SMS.
This role will ensure consistent, timely, and relevant messaging throughout the customer journey, from initial engagement through post-purchase and reactivation. Working closely with the DTC team, this role will support key business initiatives by improving how and when we communicate with our customers.

Key Responsibilities
Build and manage automated lifecycle flows (welcome, post-purchase, win-back, etc.), ensuring consistent communication across key customer stages
Execute weekly email and SMS campaigns aligned with DTC priorities, including promotions, product launches, and seasonal moments
Develop and apply customer segmentation to improve targeting, personalization, and overall relevance of messaging
Maintain CRM platform operations, including campaign setup, data quality, and deliverability standards
Track performance across campaigns and flows, providing insights to support ongoing optimization and testing
Partner with DTC, Creative, and Web teams to ensure accurate, timely, and consistent execution across all customer touchpoints

Qualifications
3–5+ years in email marketing, CRM, or lifecycle marketing within DTC
Hands-on experience with Klaviyo or similar platforms
Experience building and managing automated lifecycle flows
Strong execution skills with attention to detail and follow-through
Basic understanding of segmentation, testing, and campaign performance
Clear written communication skills for North American audiences

What Success Looks Like
Consistent execution of campaigns and lifecycle flows across key business moments
Improved structure and coverage of lifecycle communication across the customer journey
Strong CRM platform organization, data quality, and deliverability
Clear visibility into performance to support DTC decision-making
